node.title: Re: Script works fine in cmd but doesn't print to txt
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
What's going wrong is that the [doc://open] mode > clobbers the output file. Although you could use >> to append to the file, opening it on every iteration of the loop is pretty inefficient, and so [Fletch]'s [id://11102752|suggestion] of moving the open outside of the loop is better.

You should also definitely always [id://111088], and apply the advice from [id://11102684] to all of your opens.
